A Lust Pierce debuff E.G.O that inflicts Defense Level Down on enemies so allies' attacks land harder.
messages.防御レベル減少: Ⅰコインの的中時に防御レベル減少を付与する(解析Ⅲで2から4、: **Defense Level Down**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Defense Level Down on hit (from 2 to 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 5 at Ⅳ). It only lasts this turn, so it must be used before allies attack.
messages.守備威力減少: 的中時に守備威力減少2を付与する。敵が守備スキルを使うときにしか: **Defense Power Down**: Inflicts 2 Defense Power Down on hit. It only matters when the enemy uses a Defense skill, so it is a footnote.
messages.広域化(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が1から3になり、複数の敵にデバフを配れる。: **Multi-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight goes from 1 to 3, spreading the debuff across several enemies.
messages.パッシブ「拘束するリボン」: パネル最左のスキルで攻撃した対象に、次のターン、色: **Passive — Binding Ribbons**: Targets attacked by the leftmost skill on the panel receive Lust Fragility equal to Lust Absolute Resonance ÷ 4 next turn. It does not apply without at least 4 Lust Absolute Resonance.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可で、速度が最も速い対象(味方に当たり得る)を攻撃し、: **Corrosion skill**: Cannot distinguish friend from foe, attacks the fastest target (which can be an ally), and inflicts 4 Bind (on hit from Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.デバフ役として、色欲・嫉妬の資源が溜まった時点で、味方の大技の直前に撃つ。: As a debuffer, fire it right before allies' big attacks once Lust and Envy resources are available.
messages.解析Ⅳまでは単体攻撃なので、広域のデバフが欲しいなら解析Ⅳを前提にする。: It is single-target until Threadspin Ⅳ, so if you want a multi-target debuff, assume Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.威力そのものは最低限と考えられるので、資源と属性を活かす用途に絞る。: Its power is likely minimal, so limit it to uses that make the most of its resources and affinity.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が17から19、防御レベル減少が2から4になる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 17 to 19, and Defense Level Down from 2 to 4.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、防御レベル減少が5になる。実用の水準に届くのはここか: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and Defense Level Down becomes 5. This is where it reaches a practical level.
messages.ぽんぽん派ボス: S1(嫉妬)とS2(色欲)で必要資源をそのまま出せる。: **[Tingtang Gang Gangleader](persona:0603)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Lust) supply the required affinities directly.
messages.黒雲会若衆: S1が色欲で、パッシブ「黒雲刀」も色欲共鳴3で働くため、色欲の完全: **[Kurokumo Clan Wakashu](persona:0602)**: His S1 is Lust, and his passive Hēiyúndào also works at 3 Lust Resonance, making it easy to build Lust Absolute Resonance for Binding Ribbons.
